focus: Correctness and test coverage deep dive
noveltyJustification: Two direct corroborations, two sharpened with a new mechanism and a severity correction, and one genuinely new (interior-line staleness).
keyQuestions: Which correctness and failure-isolation gaps remain in each fork beyond the already-disclosed set?
Which high-value boundary, fault-injection, and live-contract tests are missing?
answeredQuestions: Which correctness and failure-isolation gaps remain in each fork beyond the already-disclosed set?
ruledOut: Treat post-rename verification as strict CAS; it detects but cannot prevent the mixed-file state

keyFindings.summary: deep-pi message_end has no stopReason guard; a zero-usage failed attempt flips usageUnavailable permanently.
deep-pi recordUsage trusts unvalidated numeric usage; cache-optimizer validates isFinite.
edit_lines validates only range endpoints; in-place interior changes are silently overwritten.
atomicWriteFile already verifies landed content post-rename; parent TOCTOU severity is overstated for deep-pi.
Both suites omit pure-cache-write, stopReason, NaN/negative, and persistence/restart cases.
